title: Is Subsequence
statement:
Decide whether one string is a subsequence of another.

The input is two lines of lowercase letters, the string `s` and then the string `t`, and either line can be empty. `s` is a subsequence of `t` when you can get `s` by deleting some of the letters of `t`, or none of them, without changing the order of the rest. So `ace` is a subsequence of `abcde`, but `aec` is not. An empty `s` is a subsequence of any string. Print `true` when `s` is a subsequence of `t` and `false` otherwise.

Input:

```text
abc
ahbgdc
```

Expected output:

```text
true
```
hints: Keep two indexes, one in `s` and one in `t`, both starting at 0. The one in `s` marks the next letter you still need to find.
Move through `t` one letter at a time. When its letter matches the letter you need from `s`, move the index in `s` forward too.
`s` is a subsequence when the index in `s` reaches the end of `s`, even if letters of `t` are left over.
